tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low pO₂, low O₂ saturation), with mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (low neutrophils and lymphocytes, elevated monocytes and basophils). These findings suggest severe respiratory compromise, likely with underlying infection or bone marrow dysfunction. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
